contract.metric: MAE in original SalePrice units; lower is better; no log transform/ranking/LLM judge
contract.artifact: UTF-8 CSV bytes with exact ordered columns Id,SalePrice; no extra/missing/duplicate headers or malformed rows. Exact ordered string IDs from caller-supplied immutable public row manifest, nonempty unique; reject ID mismatch/reordering/duplicates, preserve leading zeros; no implicit coercion or trimming.
contract.predictions: Finite numeric SalePrice values, no NaN/Inf/bool/empty/string garbage; negative finite predictions allowed mathematically, no model validity rule silently invented.
contract.reference: Caller-supplied synthetic mapping/reference bytes in tests only; actual hidden labels later only in trusted scorer process, not this planner/module fixture. Wrong reference identity/length/types is SCORER_ERROR, not a fabricated agent zero score.
contract.score: Single deterministic rederived MAE from actual input bytes; exact/finite numeric policy and rounding disclosed, no hidden-label/per-row residual output. Arithmetic overflow is typed error, not Infinity or arbitrary clipping.
contract.failure: Separate artifact INVALID versus invalid reference/metadata SCORER_ERROR; no valid score on failure. Empty task manifest is scorer error, no automatic denominator0 scoring.
contract.security: Pure parser/math, no training/network/file IO/ORX/provider/native imports. Does not establish isolation, privacy, artifact-lock authenticity, authoritative task-selection/budget enforcement or remote/durable exactly-once.
contract.resource_guard: Bound input byte/row/field sizes using explicit declared limits. Do not allocate from arbitrary malformed input before guards. P0 concrete limits not selected; tests supply small fixed synthetic limits.

tests_required: exact prediction/ID ordering and leading zeros
no source data or residual leakage in returned failures
behavioral mutation RED disabling an identity check must fail then original code restored GREEN
execution_permitted: Direct stdlib unittest with generated tiny in-memory/tmpdir synthetic test values only. No actual Kaggle training/scoring/data acquisition. Root owns final npm check once code stable.
